query: SELECT p.catalog_item_id, c.name AS drug_name, p.par_qty, p.min_qty, COALESCE(s.quantity, 0) AS "on_hand!", GREATEST(p.par_qty - COALESCE(s.quantity, 0), 0) AS "gap!" FROM ward_par_levels p JOIN pharmacy_catalog c ON c.id = p.catalog_item_id LEFT JOIN ward_stock s ON s.tenant_id = p.tenant_id AND s.department_id = p.department_id AND s.catalog_item_id = p.catalog_item_id WHERE p.tenant_id = $1 AND p.department_id = $2 ORDER BY c.name LIMIT 5000
